title: Life With MHERO I: 6 Months In
excerpt: One owner shares their experience living day-to-day with the Model 1, from desert weekends to daily commutes.
body: Six months and over 12,000 kilometers later, our Model 1 has proven itself equally capable on desert dunes and in daily city traffic.
The adaptive suspension makes the switch between terrain modes seamless, while the cabin remains a quiet, comfortable place to spend long drives.
Charging has become second nature, with most top-ups happening overnight at home.
author: MHERO Editorial Team

title: A Guide to Battery Care and Longevity
excerpt: Simple habits that help maximize the lifespan and performance of your MHERO's battery pack.
body: Battery longevity starts with charging habits. Keeping your daily charge between 20% and 80% helps preserve long-term battery health.
MHERO's thermal management system automatically regulates battery temperature, but parking in shade during extreme heat still helps.
Scheduled software updates also continue to refine charging efficiency over time.
author: MHERO Technical Team

title: The Design Philosophy Behind MHERO
excerpt: A conversation with MHERO's design team on the inspiration behind the brand's distinctive visual language.
body: Every MHERO model begins with a single question: how does form communicate capability?
Our design language draws from monolithic architecture and natural terrain, translated into surfacing that feels both solid and dynamic.
The result is a design identity that owners say they can recognize from a single glance, even at a distance.
author: MHERO Design Studio
